$Comment: The Bulwark, the defender's Focus, bought on the Defense track (Block). Its line is Health, 10 a step; its Path's other face makes Guardian's Call last longer; its signature is Mountainshield. While it is sworn every hit its holder deals is multiplied by 0.9 (the oath set's Defense kind). Every value it leaves out comes from Mmo_Focus_Base_Defense. Its steps are Mmo_Focus_Bulwark_<step>, saved in every buyer's record: never change Focus or Home on a live server.
